title: Fine-grained provisioning + periodic recertification pipeline for privileged access
creator: Aisha Khan
body: We need a reliable, auditable pipeline to enforce fine-grained provisioning (SCIM-driven groups + attribute mapping), strict RBAC role bindings with separation-of-duty constraints, and automated periodic access recertification with packaged evidence for compliance teams. This ticket covers the engineering work to: (1) extend SCIM mappings to support scoped roles and tenant-scoped groups, (2) implement a recertification workflow that emits signed evidence bundles on a cadence, (3) stream audit events and exports to the compliance evidence store with residency and retention metadata, and (4) add enforcement checks and migration tooling for existing privileged bindings. The solution must interoperate with SSO/SAML providers, support delegated approvers, and fit within Private and Dedicated deployments (respecting VPC/residency settings).
acceptance_criteria: SCIM group-to-role mapping supports tenant prefixes and attribute-based role resolution
Automated recertification job can be scheduled per-org and creates an evidence bundle containing: current bindings, approver responses, timestamps, and audit log pointers
Evidence bundles are signed, stored in the configured residency bucket, and exportable via the Console and an API endpoint
Streaming audit pipeline surfaces RBAC changes and privileged token issuance within 30s to the evidence sink
Separation-of-duty (SoD) constraints are enforced at bind-time with clear failure modes and migration script for existing violations
Integration tests exercise SCIM provisioning, SSO group sync, recert workflow, and export pipeline in both hosted and private modes
Security review signoff completed and KMS/HSM key usage documented for bundle signing
tasks: Design SCIM group attribute schema and tenant scoping rules (RFC)
Add SCIM patch endpoints for group membership provisioning and delta sync
Implement RBAC policy versioning and SoD validation hooks in auth service
Build recertification scheduler + UI flow for approvers in Console
Create evidence bundle format (JSON + manifest + signature) and storage API
Wire audit stream (Kafka) -> evidence exporter with residency metadata
Write migration tool to detect and remediate existing SoD violations
Add e2e tests and stage rollout plan; coordinate with Security & Compliance
comments: 2026-02-26 - Aisha Khan: Kickoff meeting notes added to Confluence. Decided to use tenant-prefixed group IDs rather than per-tenant SCIM endpoints to simplify private deployments.
2026-03-02 - Liam Chen: SCIM schema draft posted. Need alignment on attribute names from IAM partners (Okta, Azure AD). Added compatibility shim for legacy Azure AD group displayName mappings.
2026-03-05 - Security (Priya Desai): Requested formal threat model for the evidence signing process; flagged KMS integration as blocker for private air-gapped installs.
2026-03-08 - Liam Chen: PoC exporter emits signed bundle to staging GCS with residency tags. Performance: 450 bundles/hour on current infra. Starting load test next week.
2026-03-11 - Design (Marco Ruiz): Console mockups for recert flow uploaded. Approver UX includes one-click approve/decline and bulk decisions with justification text.

2026-03-12 - PM (Elena Park): Scope agreed for M1: SCIM mapping + recert pipeline + signed exports. M2 to include automated remediation suggestions and SSO self-service flows. Planning to present to Compliance on 2026-03-20.
notes: Migration approach: read-only detection phase -> notification -> remediation window (30 days) -> enforced remediation
For Private deployments: evidence bundles must be written to customer-managed storage and only metadata to Redwood telemetry (opt-in).
Retention metadata attached to bundles must include residency tag, retention TTL, and retention-policy-id for downstream compliance automation.
